title: Midian
summary: Raleigh names Midian in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). A son of Abraham and Keturah, named with Zimron, Iockshan, Medan, Ishbak, and Shuah. The land is the location midian, and it was not attached. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

standby.note: Standby placement only, placed with "Abraham (Abram)" (a parent). The year is that record's sort year, taken as-is. No reign length or age was added or subtracted. It is not a sort year.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter I, §. IV, sig. 160a–160b
